title: New conditions allow a whole answer

captions.physics: Returning to a thought previously unfinished
captions.energy: Finding replies suited to present conditions
captions.emotions: Feeling completion in an understood part

meaning: You can return to a thought previously unfinished and find a reply suited to present conditions, feeling completion in an understood part without restoring an entire earlier conversation.
text: Judgement in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in returning to a previously unfinished thought with another answer. The Wheel of Fortune in energy supports readiness to find a reply suited to present conditions. The World in emotions brings completion to an understood part of conversation. You can hear a question’s significance differently and answer in another form. Present wholeness requires no complete reproduction of what once failed to happen.

For example, a long walk did not happen, but later there is time for a brief exchange. You return to “I wanted to finish telling you” and hear one important thought rather than a need to repeat the whole story. **A whole answer can emerge in another form**. You can name what is now understood and feel an actual conclusion. Yet brevity does not make the earlier wish for detail unnecessary. New conditions complete one question without automatically promising time for every remaining subject or identical readiness for them.

Difficulty arises if pleasant completion of the present part covers the whole earlier intention. A remaining question supposedly loses the right to be voiced. The constructive Wheel of Fortune helps consider the actual scope of today’s possibility without assigning the entire future to it. You can value an answer received and separately discuss another subject; wholeness is not measured by length, while another form requires neither declaring everything exhausted nor immediately compensating for a missed long conversation.
